title: Theater and Stage Directions — For Beginners
skills: distinguish stage left, stage right, upstage, and downstage
interpret movement instructions in dramatic texts
connect written stage directions to theatrical performance
alignment_note: Introduces foundational theater and stage-direction terminology, including spatial directions used by actors and directors. Supports reading and performing dramatic texts, interpreting movement cues, understanding stage geography, and connecting written drama to live performance across high school English courses.
